name_input: ISGEC HITACHI ZOSEN LIMITED; ISGEC HITACHI ZOSEN LIMITED; ISGEC HITACHI ZOSEN LIMITED
mca_status: Active (per company's own site; MCA/Zauba/TheCompanyCheck blocked with HTTP 403, so MCA status not independently verified)
note: Legal entity confirmed as existing: ISGEC Hitachi Zosen Limited is a joint venture of Isgec Heavy Engineering Ltd (India) and Hitachi Zosen Corporation (Japan), listed as a JV/subsidiary on isgec.com and having its own site isgechitachizosen.com. Registered/plant address per company site: 13/B, GIDC Industrial Estate, Taluka Vagra, Distt. Bharuch 392130, Gujarat — matches the claimed state Gujarat. Company states it has been operating since 2012 (not necessarily the incorporation date; incorporation date not verified). Role: manufacturer — the site describes a modular fabrication/process-equipment manufacturing facility at Dahej (reactors, pressure vessels, converters, columns), i.e. own production, not trading. NOT verified / null: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status, revenue FY25/FY26. Reason: MCA portal, ZaubaCorp and TheCompanyCheck all returned HTTP 403 to automated access, and search engines returned no registry snippets; the company site's Investors/Annual Return pages returned 404, so no audited accounts were reachable. PAN claimed in input (AACCI8892H) could not be confirmed against any public source — 4th character 'C' would denote a company holder, but this is unverified and must not be treated as fact. Note on input data quality: declared HS 848120 (valves for oil-hydraulic/pneumatic transmission) does not match the company's actual product line (process equipment/pressure vessels, e.g. HS 8419/7309); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company is retained and the HS code should be corrected to the factual one. Industry claimed as 'IT и электроника' is also inconsistent with heavy engineering/process-equipment fabrication. No rejection: entity exists and no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found.
